verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own receipt capture and upload through the mobile app, which covers the upload path of the story. Nothing shows receipts being matched or attached to the right card transaction automatically, and there is no email-in receipt forwarding. The automated emails are outbound reminders to employees, not a way to submit receipts. Missing for 10: automatic receipt-to-transaction matching, email forwarding of receipts, detailed docs on how receipts link to transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have receipts automatically attached to the right transaction by emailing or uploading them

citations.quote: Receipt & Memo Capture: Upload receipts and memos through the free mobile app.
